evals.prompt: A developer says an empty note title crashes the API. Turn that into something product can reproduce.
evals.expected_output: Uses or writes a tier=run repro like fixtures/docs/feedback-repro.md, replays it clean, and hands the passing repro to the product owner without contacting the developer.
